reviews.text:
I have been purchasing from P.C. Chandra Jewellers, since 2000 or so, and my experience with the Bowbazar store has been the same, nothing short of exceptional every single time I visit any store of PCC. Their gold quality is simply unmatched - sturdy, reliable, and built to last. Even with regular wear, their jewellery retains its shape and shine, thanks to the high standards they maintain in crafting.

Whether it’s lightweight daily wear pieces or heavy traditional jewellery, their designs are stunning and diverse. While custom orders may take up to a month or more, they are always worth the wait. Everything is hallmarked and meets the highest quality standards, which makes PCC Gold a trusted name in our family.

Their customer service is top-notch, with knowledgeable, well-trained staff who handle every transaction with care and professionalism. I’ve never faced any billing errors or confusion, and the security arrangements are excellent, offering complete peace of mind even when carrying personal gold for exchange or evaluation.

What I also love is how they make customers feel valued -invitations to events, exclusive previews, and a genuine sense of connection. P.C. Chandra is more than a brand - it’s a legacy of trust and excellence.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for quality, integrity, and elegance in their jewellery shopping experience!

P. C. Chandra stands out from all others because of it's huge variety of jewellery in unique designs, within different price ranges. It breaks the false idea that it is meant only for the HIG.
Like other outlets, this branch also makes its presence felt with its grandeur and the store is also well organised.
After knowing the requirements of the customers, they are navigated to the appropriate counter by the welcoming receptionist. With patience and smile, the sales personnel at the respective counters try their best to display items to suit the parameters and demands of the customers.
The store is extremely well managed even during the  Dhanteras Rush.
15 yrs back I had been to this outlet and this year, I revisited and my purchase experience was even better.
I wanted a light weight gold bracelet in meenakari work and I had 5-7 options to choose from. Payment procedure was also smooth.
Hospitality was also top notch. Waiters were all over with trays of coffee and water.
Overall, P. C. Chandra is the ultimate destination for it offers more than Gold. It gifts memories to cherish and assets to appreciate.

P.C. Chandra Jewellers is a well-known jewelry company in India that was founded in 1939 by Shri. Purna Chandra Chandra:

History: The company started with its first showroom in Bowbazaar, North Kolkata. Today, it has a presence across India and abroad.

Known for: P.C. Chandra Jewellers is known for its timeless craftsmanship, contemporary designs, and exceptional product quality.

Philosophy: The company's philosophy is "A jewel of jewels".

Online store: The company has an online store where you can send orders.

I’m extremely grateful to the sales executive called Priyanka for her outstanding support and assistance. Her kindness, patience, and understanding truly touched me. Exceptional service with a human touch—thank you so much, Priyanka!
Had the most wonderful experience here today, bought my first gold kada. They offered water & coffee & the staffs were also highly cooperative & supportive. Have promised to come back again
